views.css: *{box-sizing:border-box}body{background:#fff}.app{margin:0 auto;background:#fff;color:#202124;font:14px/1.5 -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",Arial,sans-serif;border:1px solid #e4e5e7;border-radius:9px;overflow:hidden}.jv-field{font:inherit;color:inherit;line-height:inherit;letter-spacing:inherit;text-align:left;white-space:inherit;max-width:100%;overflow-wrap:anywhere;cursor:text;border:0;border-radius:3px;padding:0;background:transparent}.jv-field:hover{background:#f1f3f5;outline:none!important}.jv-field:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #5f65d8;outline-offset:3px}.sample-note{font-size:11px;color:#80848c;padding:13px 24px;margin:0;border-top:1px solid #f0f0f1}h1,h2,p{margin:0}.muted{color:#70757a}svg{vertical-align:middle;flex-shrink:0}@media(max-width:550px){.app{border-radius:6px}.sample-note{padding:12px 18px}}.notion{max-width:960px;color:#37352f;border-color:#e9e9e7}.notion header{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:14px 20px;font-size:13px;color:#787774}.notion article{max-width:760px;margin:26px auto 44px;padding:0 44px}.page-icon{font-size:48px;line-height:1.3;margin-bottom:13px}.notion h1{font-size:38px;font-weight:750;letter-spacing:-1.1px;line-height:1.25;margin-bottom:23px}.props{display:grid;grid-template-columns:138px minmax(0,1fr);align-items:center;gap:12px 10px;font-size:14px}.label{display:flex;gap:10px;color:#787774}.label>span{font-size:13px}.pill{display:inline-block;padding:1px 7px;border-radius:4px;font-size:12px}.blue{background:#d3e5ef;color:#31546b}.blue:before{content:"●";font-size:8px;margin-right:5px}.red{background:#ffe2dd;color:#9e5046}.people,.person{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px}.people{flex-wrap:wrap}.avatar{display:inline-grid;place-items:center;width:21px;height:21px;border-radius:50%;font-size:10px;background:#e7dfd5;color:#7a6750}.body{border-top:1px solid #e9e9e7;margin-top:27px;padding-top:27px;white-space:pre-wrap;line-height:1.75;font-size:15px}.notion .sample-note{color:#9b9a97;border-color:#f0f0ee}@media(max-width:550px){.notion article{padding:0 22px;margin-top:20px}.notion h1{font-size:30px}.props{grid-template-columns:105px minmax(0,1fr);font-size:13px}.page-icon{font-size:40px}}
